briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.2%, S&P 500 +0.2%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($289.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, so per past lessons we held rather than forcing a buy on a neutral day, letting existing stop-loss/profit-target rules manage the 7 open positions.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Patience in investing means not feeling pressured to act just because you have cash available or the market is open. On a neutral day with limited funds, waiting for a genuinely strong setup — rather than forcing a mediocre trade — protects capital for better opportunities later.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 投資中的「耐性」是指不因為手上有現金或市場開盤，就感到必須立即行動。在市況平淡、資金有限的日子，等待真正強勢的進場訊號，而非勉強進行普通交易，能為日後更好的機會保留資本。

market_education.summary_en: Both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 traded essentially flat today, up just 0.2% each, suggesting investors were in a wait-and-see mode without a strong catalyst to push prices meaningfully in either direction. Screened momentum candidates like NG, HYMC, and EXK showed bullish technical setups, but none triggered the multi-signal, risk-on conviction needed to deploy limited cash. With no major market-moving headlines to point to today, the tape reflects a quiet consolidation day rather than a directional move.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日納指與標普500指數表現平淡，分別僅上升0.2%，反映投資者在缺乏明確催化劑下採取觀望態度。雖然篩選名單中的NG、HYMC、EXK等股票技術面呈現看漲訊號，但未達到足以動用有限現金的多重確認條件。今日並無重大市場消息可供參考，盤面更像是溫和的整固，而非明確方向性的走勢。
